summary: Kootenai National Forest tower in Lincoln County: camp 1921, L-4 tower 1934, destroyed 1959. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Recorded as destroyed in 1959 and listed as gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the mountain

events.note: Camp recorded at the site (firelookout.com gives only 'camp')
Recorded as destroyed; the source gives no cause

evidence.supports: 6 miles WSW of Sylvanite Ranger Station
FFLA lists a tower with status Gone

notes_for_editor: The 1921, 1934 and 1959 dates come from firelookout.com alone; the FFLA list confirms only Tower and Gone. Two searches found no staffing, fire or cause-of-destruction history. The county list gives only the legal location. R.S. is read as Ranger Station, the same abbreviation the county list uses. Record elevation_m is null; firelookout.com gives 6538 ft.
